🛒 BAZAAR — BUY & UPGRADE

🪙 0
One wallet · everything you own applies in every mode
MOVE: WASD / arrows, or left thumb joystick (drag left side).
AIM: right thumb stick — touch & drag anywhere on the right side to aim. Left runs, right aims, at the same time.
WEAPONS: tap 💣 / 🔫 anytime to switch — the glowing one is active.
💣 SMOKE: tap 💣 — smoke drops at your feet instantly (8s cloud). Cops lose your trail, beams can't pass. F = same panic drop.
🔫 WATER GUN (AR): with 🔫 active, PUSH the right stick past halfway to spray full-auto (7 rounds/sec, 380px range) — drag to sweep the aim mid-spray, ease off to aim without firing, release to stop. Soak KOs (at base damage): Constable 8 rounds · Inspector/Lathi/Armed 12 · Riot 16 · Reporter 8. 10-round mag, auto-reloads (1.2s) from reserve. 💧 droplets = +20 reserve (cap 120). Gun damage scales with level (weak early, strong late) — and with shop upgrades. Bosses are too armored — and firing alerts nearby cops.
🪙 COINS & UPGRADES: KOs earn +3 🪙, finishing a level +20+2×level. Spend them in the 🛒 BAZAAR on the main menu — outfits with signature powers, gun damage, mag size, smoke radius, duration, grenade capacity and the full police loadout.
📢🪁☂️🐕 POWERS: tap 📢 Speech (allies faster, nearby cops hesitate, 6s) · 🪁 Kite (flies off, cops near it stop and stare, 6s) · ☂️ Umbrella (no catch, no camera beams, 6s, you move slower) · 🐕 Dog (runs at cops, barks them back, 5s). 2 charges each per match.
DESKTOP: mouse aims the water gun — click/hold to spray (🔫). B/G/F = smoke at feet.
GOAL: reach the stage at the center.
🚩 MANCH STANDARD: the stage demands a minimum march — Ch1: 3, Ch2: 5, Ch3: 8, Ch4: 12, Ch5: 16 allies. Too few? You'll be turned away — go recruit!
ALLIES: touch placard-holders — they join your march. Each = +1 power.
BIG = STRONG but VISIBLE: more allies → police see you from farther.
CAUGHT: shove-match! Power (allies+1) vs cop strength.
  👮 Constable 1 · 🕵 Inspector 2 · 🛡 Riot 3
  Every clash costs 1 ally — win or lose. Lose → allies drop by 1 + their strength. Caught with 0 allies = BUSTED.
📹 REPORTER: its camera beam slanders you — 2s on air = -2 allies + it goes 🔴 LIVE, calling nearby cops to your position every 3s! They hunt in packs of 2–3 now. Watch for the ⭐ STAR ANCHOR (bigger, gold trim, camera crew) — tougher, links faster, +25 🪙 bounty. KO it or break line of sight!
📡 BROADCAST: reporters talk allies away — 3s inside the pulsing zone = -1 ally. Keep moving!
🥢 LATHI (Lv 21+): longer shove reach — don't let it close in.
🔫 ARMED GUARD (Lv 21+, rare): lobs tear gas — red ring = move! Gas = -1 ally + slow.
👹 BOSSES (Lv 10/20/30/40/50/60): SHOOT them! Your water gun and balloons now bite boss HP — the bar shows the pool. Armor 🛡 = the Damage tier that bites at 100%: one tier below lands at 65%, so keep the gun upgraded (each chapter boss is the wall for its tier). Walking an ally in still lands a heavy sacrifice hit (12% of the pool). At half HP the boss enters PHASE 2 — watch the telegraphs!
COVER: giant stone yantras block sight AND movement. Use them.
